authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W01-W05 + accepted W07 target semantics where referenced
defaults.mission: Gateway/auth transport, realtime job/command sessions, progress/cancellation and Device Gateway registration/session/trust/reconnect/replay/revoke/evidence ingress; session trust is never business/action authority.
sources: - Action Plan v0.4.1 W14 + Device amendment

tasks.title: W14-00 - Gateway & Device Session Coordination / Namespace Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W01-W05 and W07 accepted target semantics.
2. Freeze gateway/realtime/session ownership and shared contracts.
3. Make canonical DeviceId/DeviceRef decision under W14 ownership without duplicating W01 IDs.
4. Define DP3 publication barrier consumed by W15.
5. Create risk/premortem for session hijack, replay, reconnect duplicates, stale trust and forged receipt ingress.
tasks.forbidden: Do not execute native device capabilities or create business authority.

tasks.title: W14-A - Gateway Authentication & Transport
actions: 1. Implement authenticated gateway transport and request/session correlation.
2. Bind actor/tenant/session context explicitly.
3. Define protocol errors, deadlines, cancellation and connection lifecycle.
4. Fail closed on malformed/unauthenticated context.
5. Add reconnect/auth expiry tests.
tasks.forbidden: Transport authentication must not be treated as permission for an action.

tasks.title: W14-B - Realtime Command / Job Session
actions: 1. Implement realtime command/job session model.
2. Track submitted/accepted/running/waiting/cancelled/completed/failed/uncertain states as appropriate.
3. Propagate correlation/causation and deadlines.
4. Support backpressure and bounded outstanding commands.
5. Add duplicate/reorder/session-resume tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not perform side effects; execution remains W07/target executor.

tasks.title: W14-C - Progress, Lane/DAG Status & Cancellation
actions: 1. Stream safe job/lane/DAG progress and cancellation state.
2. Expose summaries/reasons/evidence refs without private chain-of-thought.
3. Make cancellation idempotent and race-safe.
4. Handle late completion after cancellation request.
5. Add client reconnect/progress replay tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not expose private reasoning or let UI state change authority.

tasks.title: W14-D - Device Registration & Canonical Device Reference
actions: 1. Define/register canonical DeviceId/DeviceRef under W14 ownership.
2. Bind device registration to tenant/identity references where applicable.
3. Model lifecycle: registered/active/revoked/compromised/retired as appropriate.
4. Prevent duplicate parallel TabletId/MobileId primitives.
5. Add wrong-tenant/re-registration/revocation tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not store local device secrets in governance/evidence.

tasks.title: W14-E - Device Session Trust / Attestation Reference
actions: 1. Implement authenticated device session and trust/attestation reference model.
2. Track freshness/expiry/revocation and device-binding context.
3. Expose trust as execution precondition metadata only.
4. Fail closed on stale/revoked/ambiguous device session.
5. Add hijack/attestation-stale tests.

tasks.title: W14-F - Realtime Device Command Delivery, Reconnect & Replay Protection
actions: 1. Deliver W07-compatible command references to connected device sessions.
2. Use W03 idempotency/durable semantics for reconnect/offline-safe delivery coordination.
3. Deduplicate command replay and preserve ordering where required.
4. Never blindly redeliver EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN side effects.
5. Test disconnect/reconnect/duplicate/late ack scenarios.

tasks.title: W14-G - Session Revoke/Kill & Receipt/Evidence Ingress
actions: 1. Implement session revoke/kill behavior.
2. Accept device Receipt/Evidence ingress with authentication/correlation/provenance validation.
3. Reject forged/stale/wrong-device receipts.
4. Support late receipt classification after disconnect/revoke.
5. Add kill-switch and evidence-forgery tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not decide business outcome or authority from receipt presence alone.

tasks.title: W14-H - Gateway/Device Integration & DP3 Acceptance
actions: 1. Run client mock and device gateway mock end-to-end.
2. Test auth expiry, reconnect, duplicate commands, stale trust, revoke/kill, cancellation and evidence ingress.
3. Run four Risk Gates, performance budgets and exact-head CI.
4. Publish accepted device session/gateway contracts for W15 (DP3).
5. Produce explicit W15 handoff.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement W15 Android runtime.
